topic: An MFA review should include the help-desk account recovery path, not just the sign-in screen
audience: Canadian IT leaders and business leaders responsible for identity security
objective: Challenge the assumption that enabling MFA completes identity protection. Use the documented recovery-reset tactic to explain why verification during recovery matters, while retaining the advisory's recommendation for phishing-resistant MFA. Offer one practical review question, not a promise of prevention or an invented customer story.

evidence.title: S2 / C3: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, July 29, 2025
evidence.fact: The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security urges organizations covered by the Scattered Spider advisory to regularly test their cyber security business processes, including those used by their service providers.
